Package com.egradx.auth

Class EgradxAuthorityCatalog

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.EgradxAuthorityCatalog
public class EgradxAuthorityCatalog extends Object
Every authority egradx-auth manages: its own (EgradxAuthorities) plus those contributed by other libraries (EgradxAuthorityContributor). The single answer to "which are platform-only" and "what does an organization's Admin get", so that a contributed authority is protected by exactly the same rule as egradx-auth's own.
